analysis.narrativeEn:

· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.5073 → 2.0597) — Confirmed bullish expansion signal after bottoming out.

· 5-day/20-day high pattern (Higher High) — Confirming continuation of uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — Entered short-term overbought zone, consider shifting to wait-and-see if further upside occurs.
